guards.source: Exact HEAD plus guarded tracked diff/untracked closure; marker/evidence/runner/helper/Cargo hashes are rechecked. Root must not edit protected source or evidence while it runs.
guards.idle: Waits for300seconds, then captures last-input tick after source checks and rechecks idle before launch.
guards.input: Checks input with500ms loop interval plus guard cost; records early stop reason, kills only its owned Cargo tree, performs final input observation, and stops later selected groups. No auto retry on input.
guards.logs: Bounded writer-quiescent same-byte UTF8/hash capture. Locked/missing/invalid logs, cleanup/provenance errors or missing terminal summaries cannot pass.
guards.failure_collection: Ordinary test failures collect all selected groups; input/source/STOP/runner/evidence failure terminates admission to later groups. Unselected groups have no fresh result.

guards.stop: Only the fresh capacity directory STOP is checked. STOP/source failures set blockedReason so later tasks become not_run_after_guard_failure.
guards.ordinary_failures: Other failed/timed-out/insufficient plans remain explicit; later selected plans can still collect normal outcomes.

capacity_runner.claim_boundary: Headless sustained selected-population throughput only; no rendered FPS, original-runtime parity, trainer or unselected population claim.

shared_lease.scope: Same Darwinbots worktree GPU/capacity runners, including older runner versions that use this identity.
shared_lease.mechanism: OpenOrCreate ReadWrite FileShare.None stream; stale file content alone is not an active lease.
shared_lease.lifetime: No explicit final lease Dispose is present in the runners. Launch each invocation in a separate fresh pwsh process, wait for exit and owned worker closure before the next; process exit releases the OS handle.
shared_lease.do_not: Do not delete or force-release a held lease, dot-source runners, assume a persistent session has released its stream, or treat this lease as A-Life/Bob resource arbitration.

shortest_serial_sequence.launch_policy: Root launches each payload as a new hidden pwsh.exe process, serially. Wait for process exit and sealed normal outcomes/owned worker closure before moving on. Do not start the next after an input/provenance/owner STOP without fresh root admission and300seconds idle.
shortest_serial_sequence.selected_group_recovery: If user input interrupts a group, preserve its failed/stopped attempt. A later fresh run may select only the still-unqualified groups via-Groups after new root resource/idle admission; it does not reuse a passing status from an interrupted attempt.
